name: designing-saas-tenancy

method.focus: define tenant identity, data ownership, isolation, provisioning, lifecycle, and operational boundaries
steps: Choose tenancy model from isolation, cost, scale, compliance, and migration requirements.
Define tenant context propagation through authentication, authorization, storage, queues, caches, logs, and background jobs.
Make every tenant-scoped query and side effect structurally require tenant identity.
Plan provisioning, suspension, deletion, export, backup, restore, and tenant migration.
Create cross-tenant negative tests and operational detection signals.
verification: Can any identifier be used without tenant context?
Are caches and async jobs tenant-safe?
Can administrators cross boundaries only through audited authority?
Can one tenant be restored or deleted without affecting others?
